## Installation

1. Download and install [GTA Vice City The Definitive Edition Fusion Mod](https://fusionfix.io/wfp#gtavcde), or the required x64 version of the [ASI Loader](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader).
2. Download [Fusion Rain Droplets for GTA Vice City The Definitive Edition](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/FusionRainDroplets/releases/download/gtavcde/GTAVCDE.FusionRainDroplets.zip) and put the `.asi` file into the `scripts` folder of `Gameface\Binaries\Win64`.
3. Launch the game - the drops of the effect are visible while it rains.

Used Xbox Rain Droplets before? Delete the old `GTAVCDE.XboxRainDroplets.asi`: while it is there, the game shows a message and closes.

## Notes

- The drops are drawn in the middle of the frame of the game, so the HUD of the Definitive Edition stays readable behind them.
- Change the settings on [fusionfix.io](https://fusionfix.io) or in FusionFixHub; changes apply while the game runs. They are stored in the `.cfg` next to the plugin.
